group_memory.hint: Separate keeps what someone says in a group apart from their private chats with the bot, so a group reply cannot reveal a private conversation.

record_groups.hint: Only messages that reach the model (for example when the bot is mentioned) are remembered.

directory.hint: Leave empty to keep memory in AstrBot's data/plugin_data/membrain, which survives plugin updates and is included in AstrBot data backups.

roleplay_character.hint: If this bot plays a fictional character, give its name: the story's memory is then kept apart from each person's real-life memory.

share_real_life.description: Share real-life notes with the role-play
share_real_life.hint: Show each person's non-sensitive real-life notes in the role-play, marked as real life.

extract_model.hint: AstrBot's model already saves notes with the membrain_note tool when it supports tool calls. If it does not, give an OpenAI-compatible model (for example deepseek-chat) and memBrain reads each finished turn with it, after the reply, to save lasting facts as notes. Each turn costs one extra call.
